# Starfighters Space Reschedules Investor Update to Nov. 20


November 06, 2026 9:00am EST


*High-level events at Starfighters’ Florida facility cause conflict with planned investor call*


KENNEDY SPACE CENTER, Fla.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--[Starfighters Space, Inc.](https://starfightersspace.com/) ("Starfighters" or the "Company") (NYSE American: FJET), the space company operating the world's only commercial fleet of flight-ready Mach 2+ supersonic aircraft, must reschedule a live briefing by CEO Tim Franta from Nov. 6 to Nov. 20. A newly announced visit by senior government officials to the Company’s hangar at Kennedy Space Center on Nov. 6 will require Mr. Franta’s presence during the hours previously planned for the investor update. The government officials will provide a public announcement on aerospace policy during an event in the Company’s hangar.


“This timing conflict could not be avoided, but I remain committed to providing an update on our operations and business development,” said Tim Franta, CEO of Starfighters.


**Briefing Details**


**Date:** Friday, Nov. 20, 2026
**Time:** 4:00 p.m. ET
**Format:** Live webcast
**Registration:**[https://us06web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_lTtMjEVvSyaiomCDsPpH3A](https://us06web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_lTtMjEVvSyaiomCDsPpH3A)


A replay of the briefing will be available following the event on the Investor Relations section of the Company’s website at[starfightersspace.com](https://starfightersspace.com/) for a period of 30 days.


**About Starfighters Space, Inc.**


[Starfighters Space](https://starfightersspace.com/) (NYSE American: FJET) operates its fleet of F-104 aircraft at Kennedy Space Center in Florida and the Midland International Air & Space Port in Texas, making it the only company in the world with the commercial capability to fly at sustained Mach 2+ speeds, supporting a variety of aerospace applications. The iconic F-104 jets are configurable as a platform for air-launched payloads, training for pilots, and to support RDT&E (Research, Development, Test, and Evaluation) for hypersonic technologies, advanced materials, missile defense systems, microgravity science, spaceflight hardware validation, and defense electronic systems.
